# Maskotspesialisten

> Maskotspesialisten er Norges leverandør av skreddersydde, håndlagde maskoter av høy kvalitet — for idrettslag, bedrifter, arrangementer og merkevarer som vil skille seg ut. Hver maskot er designet og produsert fra bunnen av basert på kundens idé, merkevare og behov.

Maskotspesialisten (English: "The Mascot Specialist") is a Norwegian company that designs and produces custom mascot costumes. Unlike off-the-shelf mascots, every mascot is built from scratch based on the client's concept, brand colors, and intended use — from initial sketches through prototyping to the finished wearable costume.

The process runs end-to-end: idea and concept → sketches → 3D/pattern prototype → production → finished delivery. Clients receive progress updates throughout and see sketches and production photos before the final costume is delivered.

Typical customers include sports clubs (idrettslag), corporate brands (bedrifter), public institutions, and event organizers in Norway. Notable reference customers include Oslo universitetssykehus (Oslo University Hospital).

## Services

- [Skreddersydde maskoter](https://maskotspesialisten.no/): Fully custom mascot design and production, tailored to brand, character, and use case.
- [Slik fungerer det](https://maskotspesialisten.no/slik-fungerer-det/): Step-by-step walkthrough of the production process, from first sketch to finished mascot.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Company name: Maskotspesialisten
- Country: Norway
- Industry: Custom mascot design and manufacturing
- Service model: Bespoke, made-to-order (not stock / off-the-shelf)
- Target customers: Sports clubs, businesses, public institutions, event organizers
- Process: Concept → sketches → prototype → production → delivery, with client approval at each stage
- Languages served: Norwegian and English
